services.title: MOON Astra shared world API (PRODUCTION)

stores.note: the live world; accumulates player state continuously

backup_lane.mechanism: tools/moon_astra_backup.py — sqlite ONLINE BACKUP API on the host (never a cp of a live db, never a service stop) -> integrity_check + per-table row counts on the hub -> gzip+sha256 -> scp to workstation -> local sha256 must equal the hub's -> local OPEN whose row counts must equal the hub's
backup_lane.note: Born 2026-09-05: before that the world had been live and accumulating state with ZERO backups — /var/backups/moon-astra did not exist at all.

services.verified_how: ssh aiciv-hub systemctl show + ss -lntp + nginx -T + certbot certificates + stat; public HTTPS probe from the workstation returned 200

services.title: MOON Astra STAGING world API (isolated from production)

stores.note: StateDirectory grants the ONLY writable path; ProtectSystem=strict means this unit CANNOT reach the production world file

backup_lane.why_not: DELIBERATE, and stated so it is a decision rather than an oversight: staging is a disposable world fed by the Netlify branch-deploy preview. Losing it costs a redeploy, not player state.
backup_lane.if_that_changes: add a second --label to tools/moon_astra_backup.py pointing at /var/lib/moon-astra-staging/world.sqlite; owner fleet-lead

config_hazards: MOON_PUBLIC_ORIGIN is a SINGLE origin (new URL(...).origin), not a list — a second origin cannot be appended. Fails CLOSED with ORIGIN_REJECTED for every other origin, by design.
Staging trusts https://deploy-moon-astra--aiciv-inc.netlify.app only. NEVER put that origin on the production unit; production trusts https://ai-civ.com only.
services.verified_how: ssh aiciv-hub systemctl show + ss -lntp + nginx -T + certbot certificates + stat; public HTTPS probe from the workstation returned 200
